summary: Quote mode: the day OHLC packet before any last-trade packet, then the trade; the first frame has no traded price to report.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The desktop sends its receipt time as ltt: Motilal's packets carry no trade time either side reads (the packet header's time is undocumented and unused), and the web sends no ltt. A receipt time is not a trade time (lead decision 2026-11-09): mark the last trade time absent.

The desktop sends the canonical last_quantity in every broker's Quote and Depth frames and the web adapter's own name (ltq) beside it with the same value (feed::dialect, WS-05); this web adapter sends ltq only.
Motilal's packets carry no book totals; the desktop sends 0, the web leaves the total out. Mark the totals absent.
Motilal's packets carry no book totals; the desktop sends 0, the web leaves the total out. Mark the totals absent.

The day OHLC packet before any trade: both sides send a Quote frame with LTP zero (the desktop 0.0, the web 0) though nothing has traded. The desktop is to send nothing until the first last-trade packet; the web's zero LTP is then a web defect.
As ltp: before any trade the desktop sends average price 0.0, the web 0.
